rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese expression for making harsh breathing noises while asleep.

example.english: I snore in my sleep all the time, so the person in the next room can't sleep.
example.traditional: 我瞓覺時成日打鼻鼾，搞到隔籬房嘅人都瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan3 gaau3 si4 seng4 jat6 daa2 bei6 hon4 gaau2 dou3 gaak3 lei4 fong4 ge3 jan4 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for the snoring sound or the act of snoring.

example.english: My dad starts to snore as soon as he falls asleep, and the whole house can hear it.
example.traditional: 我阿爸一瞓着就打鼻鼾，成屋都聽到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 jat1 fan3 zoek6 zau6 daa2 bei6 hon4 sing4 uk1 dou1 teng1 dou3
